title: Service Sector Performance
definition: The service sector (tertiary sector) performance measures the contribution, value addition, productivity, employment generation, and external trade competitiveness of intangible economic activities in India.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE GS Paper III (Indian Economy & issues relating to planning, mobilization of resources, growth, development, and employment) and Prelims regarding GDP composition, GVA, and service exports.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Service Sector Performance.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
